critical_issues.msg: VALID_STATUSES contains values not in the CustomerStatus enum ('partner', 'prospect', 'active', 'blocked'), causing ValueError in count_by_status when any customer has those statuses.
critical_issues.suggestion: Align VALID_STATUSES with CustomerStatus values, or expand the enum to include all seven statuses (add PARTNER, PROSPECT, ACTIVE, BLOCKED).

critical_issues.msg: NotFoundException uses Chinese '客户' while all other exception messages in this file and the codebase use English — inconsistent, unhelpful in logs/traces.
critical_issues.suggestion: Use 'Customer' in NotFoundException to match the English convention used everywhere else.

critical_issues.msg: NotFoundException uses Chinese '客户' — same inconsistency as line 100.

suggestions.msg: No logging calls anywhere in the service — raised exceptions (NotFoundException, ValidationException) have no trace in logs, violating Rule 41.
suggestions.suggestion: Add a logger (e.g. logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)) and log at error level before raising exceptions, including tenant_id and customer_id for traceability.

suggestions.msg: bulk_import calls session.add() individually inside a loop; session.add_all(customers) would be more efficient and idiomatic for bulk inserts.
suggestions.suggestion: Replace the loop with session.add_all([CustomerModel(...) for c in customers]) followed by a single flush().

suggestions.msg: auth_headers_web commits async_session (line 355 in conftest) before test_count_by_status_tenant_isolation runs, persisting a user record into tenant_id_web's scope across tests in the same module — minor data leakage.
suggestions.suggestion: Have auth_headers_web use its own session instance rather than committing via the shared async_session fixture, or scope tenant_id_web to 'function' to avoid cross-test pollution.

suggestions.msg: TestCustomerServiceIntegration, TestPipelineServiceIntegration, TestSalesServiceIntegration, TestCustomerCountByStatusIntegration lack @pytest.mark.asyncio — relies on asyncio_mode=auto in pytest.ini; works but is implicit.
suggestions.suggestion: Add @pytest.mark.asyncio to each test class for explicitness and defense against future pytest-asyncio configuration changes.

suggestions.msg: TestSalesServiceIntegration imports SalesService, PipelineService, UserService but none of the test classes (TestCustomerServiceIntegration, TestPipelineServiceIntegration) use the fixtures from conftest that are specific to those services — mixing two concerns in one file.
suggestions.suggestion: Split into test_pipeline_service_integration.py and test_sales_service_integration.py to follow the one-domain-per-file convention used by test_customer_service.py.

suggestions.msg: test_count_by_status_empty mocks result.all() with AsyncMock(return_value=[]) — but SQLAlchemy's Result.all() is synchronous and returns a plain list, not a coroutine; mock signature does not match the real API.
suggestions.suggestion: Change to mock_result.all = MagicMock(return_value=[]) (synchronous MagicMock, matching SQLAlchemy's synchronous interface), consistent with how test_count_by_status_returns_counts sets up the same mock.

suggestions.msg: sys.path.insert(0, ...) duplicates work already done by tests/unit/conftest.py lines 34-35; redundant and can mask import errors that PYTHONPATH would otherwise surface.
suggestions.suggestion: Remove the sys.path manipulation entirely and rely solely on the conftest setup.
